eval_sh_spherical_harmonics: evaluate spherical harmonics coefficients at unit directions for a given degree using hardcoded SH polynomials
eval_sh_batched_directions: evaluate spherical harmonics on batched direction tensors with configurable degree from 0 to 4

review_sh_utils_constants: review the spherical harmonics normalization constants C0 through C4 used in SH polynomial evaluation
